[B1] < deviceB | 'buttonPressed' : false , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'buttonPressed' : true , ... > .

[B2] < deviceB | 'buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : OldKey , ... > $ UserX 'setKey' deviceB | Key
=> < deviceB | 'buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceB 'sendBindingKey' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key) .

[B2] < cloudA | deviceB : ('bindingKey' : OldKey , ...) , ... > $ deviceB 'sendBindingKey' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , ...) , ... > .

[B3] < deviceB | 'buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'retrieveKey' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | Key if Key =/= nils .

[B3] < UserX | 'key' : OldKey , ... > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | Key
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .

[B4] < cloudA | deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owner' : nils , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owner' : UserX , ...) , ... > .

[B5] < cloudA | deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owner' : UserX , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'resetDevice' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('bindingKey' : '' , 'owner' : nils , ...) , ... > .

[B6] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .

[B7] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
